decision: All tested stop openings have zero or negative engagement at minimum published body width, even before positional tolerance. Do not pursue these dimensions by merely cutting the lower case.
manufacturer_handling_constraints: Manufacturer requests consultation for pressing/pushing against an object or insertion into tight spaces. No consultation performed or assumed.
Do not load sensor head when fixing; published bending diagram specifies 3mm fixing distance and 7mm lead bending distance.
1N horizontal lead pull for 10 seconds is a reliability test, not an allowable continuous retention load.
next_design_constraints: Use minimum body width for retention and maximum width for clearance, including lateral float.
Avoid treating the floating body bridge as established thermal coupling.
Resolve thermal contact without assuming permission for pressure contact from the dimensional drawing.
